question.prompt: When the global search field is focused and a search overlay is active, what should one Escape keypress dismiss?

options.label: Overlay else focus
options.detail: Assume Escape closes the search overlay when it is open; if no overlay is open, Escape clears field focus.

options.label: Dismiss both
options.detail: Assume one Escape keypress closes the overlay and clears field focus together.

options.label: Focus only
options.detail: Assume Escape clears only field focus and does not dismiss an active overlay.

options.label: Need source
options.detail: Another source is needed to define the single-Escape outcome.

content.risk_rationale: The PRD says “Escape clears focus/search overlay” but does not define the branch behavior for focus-only versus overlay-active states; scenario count and test assertions change depending on that rule.

question.prompt: What observable should prove that the focused global search border is specifically “information blue”?

options.label: Use shared token
options.detail: Assume the intended oracle is the product's shared information-blue token or its exact computed style when that mapping is available.

options.label: Any blue border
options.detail: Assume any visibly blue focused border is sufficient.

options.label: Need source
options.detail: Another source is needed to map “information blue” to a web-observable token or concrete value.

content.risk_rationale: The PRD names the target color semantically but does not provide a concrete token name or value, so a strict visual check would otherwise become subjective.

question.prompt: What starting URL should web tests use to reach the header that contains the global search field?

options.label: Use {{start_url}}
options.detail: Author later tests against a {{start_url}} placeholder until the execution environment supplies the exact URL.

options.label: Need source
options.detail: Another source is needed to name the exact web entry point for this terminal.

content.risk_rationale: The ACs are designable without an environment URL, but no runnable web test can start without a concrete or placeholder entry point.

content.text: When the global search field receives focus, its border changes to information blue.
Pressing Escape dismisses the active global search focus or overlay state.
Pressing Cmd/Ctrl + K focuses the global search field.
When the global search field receives focus, a focus ring is shown.

expected_answer.operand: visible focus ring around the focused global search field

content.text: When focused, the global search field width remains 420px.
When focused, the global search field height remains 36px.
The global search field placeholder is "Search assets, metrics, reports...".

judgements.rationale: [risk_factors] Applied only user-reach to these invariant ACs because the search field sits in the global header and affects navigation from anywhere in the terminal; I did not apply money, auth, data-loss, or change-frequency because the cited behavior is presentational and keyboard-access oriented.

[applicability] Treated the promised surface as web because the PRD specified pixel dimensions, desktop responsive behavior, header layout, and keyboard interactions without native-app launch or platform cues.
